homeHero.fallbackTitle: Handmade crochet toys, accessories, and home decor
homeHero.fallbackDescription: At Happy Colors, you’ll find unique handmade gifts created with care and attention to every detail. Discover handmade crochet toys, accessories, bags and handmade home decor designed for birthdays, special occasions, children’s rooms or simply to bring a little more color into everyday life. Our collection includes original crochet gifts and handmade crochet pieces, each with its own character and charm. Browse the collection and find something special for someone you love – or for yourself.

products.catalogTitle: Handmade crochet toys, accessories and home decor
products.catalogIntro: Explore our collection of handmade crochet toys, bags, accessories and home decor, each created with care and attention to detail. Discover soft crochet animals, amigurumi toys, toy-and-backpack sets, handmade bags and unique crochet accessories for children and adults. Whether you are looking for a special handmade gift or a beautiful piece for your home, Happy Colors offers original handmade creations with character.

products.cartoonPriceDetails: The final price depends on the number of people, complexity, style, and production timing. See details about prices and options
products.deliveryContent:
Delivery options:
- Econt or Speedy office
- Econt or Speedy parcel locker
- Box Now locker
At the moment, delivery to a personal address is not available.
Delivery price:
For orders above 50 €, delivery is free.
For orders below this amount, delivery is paid by the customer according to the courier company tariff.
Dispatch time:
Available products are dispatched within 1 business day.
Delivery time depends on the courier company and recipient location.
Unavailable products:
If the product is not available, you can send an inquiry through the contact form on the site.
